intro: Furlbrow's Pocket Watch is a cherished family heirloom belonging to Farmer Furlbrow of Westfall. Given to him by his wife Verna's father on their wedding day, the timepiece was abandoned in haste when Defias bandits seized their pumpkin farm.

p: When Defias hooligans swarmed the Furlbrow Pumpkin Patch, Farmer Furlbrow and his wife Verna were forced to abandon their homestead in the middle of the night. In the frantic rush to escape, the farmer left behind a prized pocket watch, given to him as a wedding gift by his father-in-law. The heirloom remained tucked away inside a wardrobe in the overrun farmhouse, guarded by cutthroats led by Benny Blaanco. For the displaced couple camping along the road, recovering the watch represents preserving one of the few pieces of their former life that the outlaws have not ruined.
